    exact Classical.choose_spec (h1 (x : X) x.property)
  refine ⟨V, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    exact ⟨(hVspec x).2.1, (hVspec x).1, (hVspec x).2.2⟩
  · apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · intro y hy
      rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hy with ⟨x, hyx⟩
      exact (hVspec x).2.2 hyx
    · intro y hy
      let x : A := ⟨y, hy⟩
      apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
      refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
      exact (hVspec x).1
